description:
Read recent entries from the connected Unity Editor Console. Use this tool to inspect runtime, script compilation, and Editor diagnostics without asking the user to copy Console output. Entries are returned in chronological order. Repeated entries with the same level and message are merged and include a `count`. The same result is available inside `unity_execute` through `ctx.GetConsoleLog(level, limit)`.

`level` filters the normalized Unity Console level: `error` includes errors, assertions, exceptions, and fatal logs; `warn` includes warnings; `info` includes regular Unity logs. Omit `level` to return all three levels.

`limit` controls the maximum number of merged entries returned. It defaults to 50 and is capped at 200. Filtering and duplicate merging happen before the limit is applied, so the result contains the most recent matching groups.

level.description: Optional normalized Unity Console level to return. Omit to return all levels.

limit.description: Maximum number of merged log entries to return.
